title: ADS bounded API evidence retrieval
prompt: Use only EDA Bridge Runtime tools and connection '{{ADS_CONNECTION}}'. Read capabilities exactly once for purpose 'Benchmark ADS documentation operations'. Then use eda.read operation 'docs.query' exactly once with vendor payload query='create an ADS workspace and schematic design with Python', limit=3 for purpose 'Find bounded ADS API evidence'. Select the most relevant returned source_ref and use eda.read operation 'docs.get' exactly once with vendor payload source_ref=<selected source_ref>, focus='workspace and schematic creation', max_chars=2000 for purpose 'Retrieve one bounded ADS API passage'. Do not use shell, files, browser, GUI, mutation, launch, simulation, or customer data. Do not quote or count the passage yourself. Return only a compact JSON object with status='passed', source_count copied from query result_count, and excerpt_chars copied from get returned_chars.
